steps.name: environment
steps.description: Validate Node (>=18) and npm existence/versions. Create a workspace-level helper script to prepend npm global bin to PATH when sourcing the workspace helper. Only write /etc/profile.d/npm_path.sh if the environment variable FORCE_GLOBAL_NPM_PATH=1 is set; when writing globally, verify the computed path exists and test sourcing the file in a subshell to validate syntax. Do NOT set NODE_ENV globally. Create .env.example in the workspace if absent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/two-player-tic-tac-toe-30418-30428/backend"
# verify node >=18
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
node_major=$(node -v | sed 's/^v\([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
if [ "${node_major:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node.js v18+ required (found $(node -v))" >&2; exit 3; fi
# verify npm
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: npm not found" >&2; exit 4; fi
npm_ver=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
npm_major=$(printf "%s" "$npm_ver" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "${npm_major:-0}" -lt 8 ]; then echo "WARNING: npm version ${npm_ver} is older than recommended (8+). Proceeding." >&2; fi
# create workspace helper that can be sourced to add npm global bin to PATH (idempotent)
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
HELPER="$WORKSPACE/.env_helpers.sh"
cat > "$HELPER" <<'BASH'
# workspace helper: add npm global bin to PATH if present
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PG=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$PG" ] && [ -d "$PG" ]; then
    case ":$PATH:" in
      *":$PG:"*) ;;
      *) export PATH="$PG:$PATH" ;;
    esac
  fi
fi
BASH
chmod 644 "$HELPER"
# Optionally write global /etc/profile.d/npm_path.sh only if explicitly requested
if [ "${FORCE_GLOBAL_NPM_PATH:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  profile_file=/etc/profile.d/npm_path.sh
  ts=$(date +%s)
  if sudo test -f "$profile_file"; then sudo cp -a "$profile_file" "${profile_file}.bak.$ts" || true; fi
  sudo bash -c "cat > '$profile_file' <<'BASH'
# added by automated setup (opt-in): ensure npm global bin is on PATH at login
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PG=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$PG" ] && [ -d "$PG" ]; then
    case ":\$PATH:" in
      *":$PG:") ;;
      *) export PATH=\"$PG:\$PATH\" ;;
    esac
  fi
fi
BASH"
  sudo chmod 644 "$profile_file"
  # test sourcing in a subshell to ensure syntactic validity and PATH change
  if ! sudo bash -c ". '$profile_file' && command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1"; then
    echo "ERROR: written $profile_file failed validation" >&2; exit 6;
  fi
fi
# workspace .env example
[ -f "$WORKSPACE/.env.example" ] || cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env.example" <<'ENV'
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3000
ENV
ENV
printf "ok\n"

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Start the Express server from workspace, poll /_health until ready (default timeout 30s configurable via TIMEOUT), fetch root page snippet and server log if available, then gracefully stop the server. Produce JSON evidence containing health, page_snippet, and server_log (truncated). Uses node from PATH (command -v node) to start. Depends on all prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/two-player-tic-tac-toe-30418-30428/backend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
NODE_BIN=$(command -v node || true)
[ -n "$NODE_BIN" ] || { echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
TIMEOUT=${TIMEOUT:-30}
OUTDIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/backend-validate.XXXX)
HEALTH_FILE="$OUTDIR/health.json"
PAGE_FILE="$OUTDIR/page.html"
LOGFILE="$OUTDIR/server.log"
# start server in background using local environment only
NODE_ENV=development PORT=$PORT "$NODE_BIN" index.js >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
start_ts=$(date +%s)
while true; do
  if curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/_health" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  now=$(date +%s);
  if [ $((now-start_ts)) -ge $TIMEOUT ]; then
    echo "ERROR: timeout waiting for server" >&2
    ps -o pid,cmd -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 9
  fi
  sleep 1
done
# capture health and page
curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/_health" -o "$HEALTH_FILE" || { echo "ERROR: cannot fetch health" >&2; kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 10; }
curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" -o "$PAGE_FILE" || true
# graceful stop
kill -SIGINT "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 1; done
if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -SIGTERM "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
# produce JSON evidence using python3
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  python3 - <<PY
import json
try:
  h=open('$HEALTH_FILE','r',encoding='utf-8').read()
except Exception:
  h=''
try:
  p=open('$PAGE_FILE','r',encoding='utf-8').read()[:200]
except Exception:
  p=''
try:
  s=open('$LOGFILE','r',encoding='utf-8').read()[:1000]
except Exception:
  s=''
print(json.dumps({'health': h, 'page_snippet': p, 'server_log': s}))
PY
else
  health_escaped=$(printf '%s' "$(cat '$HEALTH_FILE' 2>/dev/null || true)" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr -d '\n')
  page_escaped=$(printf '%s' "$(cat '$PAGE_FILE' 2>/dev/null || true)" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr -d '\n' | cut -c1-200)
  log_escaped=$(printf '%s' "$(cat '$LOGFILE' 2>/dev/null || true)" | sed 's/"/\\"/g' | tr -d '\n' | cut -c1-1000)
  printf '{"health":"%s","page_snippet":"%s","server_log":"%s"}\n' "$health_escaped" "$page_escaped" "$log_escaped"
fi
printf "ok\n"
